rim_band: a pink or skin-coloured band or stray texture shows between the lash line and the eye white
lower_line_broken: the lower lid edge has a thin dark line that is broken, jagged or doubled
outline_faceted: the eye openings' outlines are faceted, polygonal or wobbly instead of smooth curves
white_edge_ragged: the edge where the eye white meets the skin is ragged or distorted
corner_odd: the inner or outer eye corners look pinched, torn or distorted
lid_gap: there is a gap or seam between the lid and the eyeball
eye_marks: the eyes have stray marks, odd spots or smudges
lash_broken: the lash or lid lines look broken, jagged or uneven
